text:
alice: T-minus 45m before v2 push to edge-proxy. Plan: start with 10% west, 5% eu, 0% apac. Header negotiation is X-API-Version: v2. @deploy-bot queued. Any last-minute holds?

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by alice. Start=2026-03-20T17:00:00Z. Strategy=regional-stagger (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Telemetry hooks will be attached.

ben: Release notes pushed to docs site. Added migration note for header handling and example curl. Do we need tenant pins for enterprise customers?

maria: Recommend pinning top-5 paying tenants for the first 24h while we watch. I'll start outreach to integrations. Mobile SDK team will ship a tiny patch to ensure header casing is preserved.

ops-sre: Adding rollback triggers proposal: if p95 latency > 300ms OR 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 5 minutes -> auto-rollback. Also alert on increased fallback-to-v1 rate (>=1% sustained 5m). OK?

alice: Yes to those triggers. Also implement header fallback: missing X-API-Version => route to v1 to avoid breaking older clients during grace window.

client-sdk: Note: edge-proxy 1.9 had a header casefolding bug. We're rolling a proxy patch to 1.9.1 now (ETA ~20m). If patch doesn't land in time we should hold canary.

deploy-bot: Canary start: west=10% (edge-proxy-canary-3). Telemetry endpoints: https://telemetry.internal/rollout/5405000000. Observability dashboards linked.

ben: Going to pin tenant:acme-corp and tenant:beta-inc to v1 for 48h just to be safe. Leaving room for ops to opt-in to expansion.

maria: Also pin tenant:fin-reg and tenant:gov-demo. I'll send the integration emails now. :mailbox_with_mail: 

alice: Operators: watch fallback logs for early signs of header negotiation issues. Quick grep: 
```
grep 'fallback->v1' /var/log/edge-proxy/*.log | tail -n 200
```

ops-sre: Ack. Pager on for the first 60m of the rollout. We'll escalate if rollback triggers fire. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Canary progressed: west=10% -> health OK after 10m. No rollback triggers. Advancing eu->5% now.

client-sdk: Patch applied to edge-proxy in eu. Confirmed header preserved end-to-end in our integration tests.

deploy-bot: eu=5% health OK. Next step: scale to global 25% at T+45m unless we see anomalies.

alice: If anything odd appears, immediate rollback command is: 
```
deploy-bot rollback 5405000000 --reason="auto/ops"
```

ops-sre: Copy that. We'll keep watch and post incidents into #incidents if triggered.

deploy-bot: Status update @channel: canary healthy. Proceeding with staged rollout per plan. :)
